gap: BHD IS CLEAN, proven with a noise floor and a positive control, so this is a design verdict not leakage. Noise floor first: two IDENTICAL BHD-key runs differ by 9,931/5,184,000 px on the dashboard (box css x754-1298 y101-899, the chart frame) and 151/1,316,640 on the 390 dashboard. Against that floor, the decisive same-session A/B - BHD key forced at document-start, wave sheet ON vs its scope key neutralised in the served CSS - is 0 differing px on /customer, 0 on /invoice, 9,921 px on the dashboard (INSIDE the 9,931 floor, same box) and 143 on dashboard-390 (inside 151). The identical toggle under the pnp key moves 1,971,737 / 2,414,479 / 4,066,779 / 1,042,180 px (38.0-79.2%), so the mechanism is real and the zeros mean something. Versus the stored baseline-*.png the raw counts are large (customer 307,478; invoice 974,262; dashboard 2,437,710; dashboard-390 597,131) and I looked at them: baseline reads Meridian Supply Group / user Sam / 6 international clients, today reads Paper & Pen / user Wave / 10 Oman clients - teal #009bc1, the 220px labelled sidebar, the UPPERCASE sort-caret headers and the outlined Company pills are pixel-identical in position. Stale DATA. ALL THREE r8 ITEMS VERIFIED FIXED BY PAINT, not by class name. (1) The 16px header/number offset is gone: measured with Range rects on the glyphs, the Total header text ends at x=825.5 and every one of the ten Total digits ends at x=825.5; Paid header 978.6 and all ten Paid digits 978.6. Spread 0.0 on both columns, both edges, with tabular-nums + font-feature-settings tnum, and the sort caret sits at opacity 0 at rest so it never intrudes. 123,456.789 and 7.500 share a decimal edge and nothing overflows. (2) The toolbar is now 5 controls in 3 shape families - an 8px-radius white Search field, an 8px-radius white Filter select, two IDENTICAL 999px outlined #2b57d8 pills (Refresh, More) and one 999px solid CTA - against the bar’s one field plus three identical pills. Export to Excel and Show Deleted are behind More; on /customer the gear is labelled Columns, Views is a labelled pill and the density toggle is one segmented pill. (3) The phone strip no longer scrolls: it is flex-wrap:wrap at scrollWidth 370 = clientWidth 370, and the whole document is 390 = 390, zero horizontal overflow. THE DESIGN: ours wins, and it wins where the brief says it can. The bar never shows a money column; ours shows two, and both are dead straight - 72px rows x10 spread 0.0, header band #f1f4f9 13px/600 sentence-case on #101828, hairline #e8edf5 rules, no vertical rules, no zebra, one white container, no clipped column, the client ellipsised at Al Manara Integrated F..., the one-value Payment column muted by the uniform gate. That body reads calmer and more competent than the bar’s, whose control row is three loud blue pills over a Select all checkbox row. THE ONE REMAINING THING, and it is on the same column that decided r7 and r8: the numbers form one edge but their CURRENCY MARKS form two. Measured on Total at 1440, the gutter is not one gutter - 6 of 10 rows carry an inline SVG Rial mark occupying x699.4-719.0 (19.6px wide), the other 4 carry an 11px text span USD at x699.4-730.6 (31.2px wide, alongside a zero-width $ span still left in the DOM). So the inner edge of the money column is 719.0 on six rows and 730.6 on four - an 11.6px ragged edge inside the one column whose whole job is a straight one - and the notation itself is two systems at two type sizes, a pictograph on the OMR rows and a three-letter code on the USD rows. Worse, the mark floats free of its own number: the distance from the mark to the first digit runs 17.3px on 123,456.789 but 66.5px on 7.500, so on a two-currency ledger the reader scans 66px of white to learn whether 7.500 is Rials or Dollars, and at 1:1 the 11px Rial glyph reads as a grey speck while USD reads as a word. Give the gutter ONE notation at ONE width (a 3-letter code on every row, or the glyph on every row) so its right edge is a second straight line, and there is nothing left to say. CONCERNS, not counted against it: the locked 34x34 half-round AI tab is now flush to the viewport edge (x356-390) but still overlaps the 390 card column (x24-366) by 10.0px, down from 28; the first invoice card on the phone still starts at y=424.6 of an 844 viewport, exactly half the screen, because the wrapped 6-pill strip costs 111px in three rows; the Views pill wraps its chevron under its label at 390; both money columns paint #5b6779 (5.65:1, AA) while only the invoice Number is #101828, so the amount is lighter than the reference number; and keyboard focus on the toolbar pills is a border-weight change (1,374 px repaint, verified by cropped diff) rather than a ring.
